description: Provision a Google Cloud Sourcerepo SourceRepoRepository via Config Connector. Fields mirror the sourcerepo.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 SourceRepoRepository spec.

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

pubsubConfigs.description:
How this repository publishes a change in the repository through Cloud Pub/Sub.
Keyed by the topic names.

messageFormat.description:
The format of the Cloud Pub/Sub messages.
- PROTOBUF: The message payload is a serialized protocol buffer of SourceRepoEvent.
- JSON: The message payload is a JSON string of SourceRepoEvent. Possible values: ["PROTOBUF", "JSON"].

serviceAccountRef.description:
Service account used for publishing Cloud Pub/Sub messages. This
service account needs to be in the same project as the
pubsubConfig. When added, the caller needs to have
iam.serviceAccounts.actAs permission on this service account. If
unspecified, it defaults to the compute engine default service
account. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: Allowed value: The `email` field of an `IAMServiceAccount` resource.

name.description: Name of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

namespace.description: Namespace of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/namespaces/

topicRef.description: Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: Allowed value: The `name` field of a `PubSubTopic` resource.

name.description: Name of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

namespace.description: Namespace of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/namespaces/

resourceID.description: Immutable. Optional. The name of the resource. Used for creation and acquisition. When unset, the value of `metadata.name` is used as the default.
